description: The additively growing error-code registry. `failure_class` says who failed; `http` is the status an HTTP transport would use; SSE error events carry the same code and class. Clients map `code` to localized strings; `message` on the wire is user-safe English.

validation_failed.description: The request failed validation before it was sent.

provider_error.description: The model provider failed; upstream carries {provider, status, code}.

provider_rate_limited.description: The developer's provider key is rate-limited or out of quota upstream.

provider_auth_failed.description: The provider rejected the API key.

segment_timeout.description: The provider stream stalled past the segment deadline.

cancelled.description: The client stopped the stream; the segment ends done{cancelled}.
